record.field: Owns revenue delivery, pipeline health and deal quality.

Bookings, win rate and cycle length come from the CRM/quotation system: connect them as automatic metric sources (in Odoo, the Sales bridge collects quotations, confirmed orders and posted invoices per salesperson daily). Quota attainment is reviewed monthly by the sales manager; correct any automated figure by manual entry - manual always wins.
Owns demand generation, brand reach and funnel conversion.

Lead counts and conversion rates export from the marketing automation / web analytics tools as CSV - import them monthly with the actuals import wizard. Cost per lead and CAC are computed by finance from campaign spend reports; entered manually at month close by the marketing lead.
Owns delivery speed, production stability and platform health.

Deployment frequency, change failure rate, MTTR and lead time come from the CI/CD and incident tooling - export monthly (CSV) or record at the sprint retro. Uptime and open critical bugs are read from the monitoring dashboard and issue tracker on the last working day of each month by the engineering manager.
Owns roadmap delivery, adoption and product growth loops.

Active users, adoption, retention and activation come from the product analytics tool - export the monthly cohort report as CSV and import it. Roadmap delivery and discovery interviews are counted manually by the product manager at each monthly review.
Owns hiring speed, retention and people development.

Time to fill, offer acceptance and retention are computed from the recruitment pipeline and employee register (in Odoo: Recruitment and Employees apps). Attrition and absenteeism are calculated monthly from HR records; engagement scores import from the survey tool after each survey wave.
Owns response quality, satisfaction and revenue retention.

Response and resolution times, backlog and satisfaction come from the helpdesk system - schedule a monthly CSV export and import it. Churn and revenue retention are computed by finance from the subscription/invoice ledger at month close; the CS manager confirms each period.
Owns close discipline, forecast accuracy and cash health.

Close duration, margins, DSO and cash flow come from the accounting system itself - most can be wired as automatic metric sources against posted journal entries. Budget variance and forecast accuracy are computed in the planning spreadsheet and entered manually by the controller at each close.
Owns process reliability, cost discipline and scale readiness.

Throughput, utilization and cost per transaction come from the operations/ERP system - export the monthly operations report or connect a metric source. SLA fulfilment and incidents are logged in the ticketing/QMS tool and confirmed monthly by the operations manager.
Owns trusted data delivery and self-serve insight.

Pipeline success rate, incidents and MTTR come from the orchestrator and observability tooling - export monthly. Dashboard usage comes from the BI platform's own usage statistics; request backlog is read from the team's ticket queue on the last day of each month.
Owns usability, consistency and accessibility of the product.

Task success, error rates and time-on-task are recorded per usability test session in the research repository - enter them after each study. Satisfaction ratings import from the in-app survey tool monthly; design-system compliance is audited quarterly by the design lead.
Owns output volume, equipment effectiveness, quality and plant safety.

OEE, units produced, scrap and downtime come from the MES/SCADA line reports - export the daily production report and import it weekly, or connect a metric source if the MES writes into the ERP. Safety incidents and maintenance compliance are logged in the EHS/CMMS registers and confirmed monthly by the plant manager.
Owns stock availability, turnover, margins and supplier performance.

Turnover, stockouts, days on hand and GMROI are computed from the inventory valuation and sales reports in the ERP - schedule a monthly export and import it. Supplier OTIF and defect rates are tracked per receipt in the purchasing log; the purchasing lead confirms each month.
Owns billable utilization, on-time delivery and engagement margins.

Utilization and margins come from the timesheet and project accounting system - export the monthly utilization report as CSV and import it. On-time delivery is recorded per project at closure; client satisfaction imports from the post-engagement survey tool.
